subject.title: Feature: support message read action for Telegram

question: Should Telegram `message read` expose only gateway-observed messages through a bounded plugin-owned store, and what default action gate and retention policy should govern it?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how retained Telegram group content is authorized, stored, exposed, and documented.

options.title: Observed-only, explicit read gate
options.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action/config gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

options.title: Defer behind passive hook work
options.body: Keep this open until the passive history/plugin hook direction lands, then design `message read` on top of that contract.

options.title: Reject core read surface
options.body: Leave Telegram history retrieval to user-installed archive plugins if maintainers decide retained chat content should not be exposed through the built-in message tool.

recommendation.title: Observed-only, explicit read gate
recommendation.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action/config gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

likelyOwner.reason: They already supplied the prior detailed review and have the strongest visible routing signal for this product/security decision.
